claims.text: Strd dose (~13-15 mg/kg/day) may improve cholestatic LFTs (eg, AP) but ⍉alters progression or transplant-free survival.
claims.quote: standard doses (approximately 13–15 mg/kg/day) may improve cholestatic liver enzymes, eg, alkaline phosphatase, but do not alter disease progression or improve transplant-free survival.

claims.text: ↑dose (28-30 mg/kg/day) = linked to worse outcomes (incl ↑colorectal neoplasia risk w UC) → CI.
claims.quote: High-dose UDCA (28–30 mg/kg/day) has been linked to worse outcomes, including an increased risk of colorectal neoplasia in patients with concomitant ulcerative colitis, and is therefore contraindicated.
